name: Space elevator

elevator.basis: Edwards' NIAC elevator: a ribbon of 750 t that holds a 20 t climber, 7 t of climber with 13 t of payload, a week to the top and about 5 t a day. Three climbers keep 5 t a day on a week's climb (5 t times 7 days over 13 t); each climber is Edwards' first-climber breakdown without its cable and splicing, scaled to 7 t: structure as CFRP, thermal control as aluminium, the photovoltaic receiver as multi-junction cells, the motors as machinery, attitude, command and power control as radiation-hardened ICs. It draws the 20 MW of Edwards' power beaming stations and is run by his 140 people on two platforms. Cargo only; the same on every body

bpBasis: Edwards' estimate: the space elevator could be operational in 15 years for $10B
